speech bridge start.#comment: Speech action bridge (Mission Companion, speech commands). Started by objective1 at every load and by the SPEECH COMMANDS switch of the tablet Settings; does nothing while the setting is off. One thread, one running copy (speech_bridge_running). Contract: docs/architecture/SPEECH_ACTIONS.md and speech-contract.json, generated by tools/speech-bridge.js.

speech bridge loop.#comment: Contract first (ready 0, code, a fresh session, a clean mailbox and every availability at 0), then ready 1. The Companion writes the request session, the command and, last, the sequence; the mission answers with the result and, last, the acknowledgement sequence (1 clicked, 2 not available now). On shut-down or when the setting goes off ready and every availability return to 0.

speech readback.#comment: Feedback of an accepted spoken command (user request 2026-10-24): after the click (result 1) the copilot reads the command back by voice, pack message CMD.<code> (six options, intercom or voice by the Mission Companion rules). A refused command (result 2) is not read back. Param code.

speech commands page.#comment: Generated by tools/speech-bridge.js from tools/speech-info.json and tools/speech-phrases.json; never edit by hand. The Mission Companion tab Voice commands shows the same list from docs/architecture/speech-contract.json.

speech tips line.#comment: Generated by tools/speech-bridge.js (tipsLine). Composes the tips line from the availability variables of the speech bridge; the thread SPEECH TIPS shows it every other 5 s in place of the status bar.

speech read dispatch.#comment: Voice command "repeat dispatch": the dispatcher reads the dispatch and the objective again (the macro "voice read dispatch" skips a description it already read, so its memory is cleared first). Generated by tools/speech-bridge.js.

speech read briefing.#comment: Voice command "read briefing": the copilot or the doctor (chosen at random) reads the description of the dispatch from the briefing, the same text with a key as the dispatcher (DSC.<ID_CARD>.<variant>), on the intercom.

speech patient status.#comment: Voice command "patient status": in flight the doctor answers on the intercom (PST.F.*, actor 3); during the ground operations (ops_progress_active 1) the ground team answers on the polycon (PST.G.*, actor 3, radio on). One line per patient of the registry: stable, under lifescore 60 serious, under 30 critical, 0 deceased; a patient not assessed yet is reported as unknown (the registry only tells what a visit established).

speech destination say.#comment: Voice commands "distance to destination" / "time to destination" (sd_what distance or time): the copilot gives the distance (km, one decimal) or the time at the ground speed to the destination of the phase: the landing spot (or the accident) before the patient is loaded (MISSION_PHASE up to 6), the hospital of the dispatch from 7, the base from 10. Under 30 kt the time is not estimable. sp_result is set to 1 only when the copilot spoke.

speech availability.#comment: Availability of every declared action = its button exists and its show_condition holds now (copied from the definition by tools/speech-bridge.js; tools/test-speech-bridge.js fails when they diverge). A failing read counts as not available.

speech action run.#comment: Clicks the user action of the code (trigger_user_action = the click of the button, same limits) only while the button exists and its condition holds now; sp_result 1 = clicked, 2 = not available. Param code.

speech availability clear.#comment: Every availability variable back to 0 (bridge stopped).
